FIELDS.NAME: Brewed Awakenings Coffee House
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Manager, Brewed Awakenings Coffee House, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@brewedawakenings.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Brewed Awakenings Coffee House specializes in serving a variety of freshly brewed coffees, teas, and light snacks in a warm, inviting atmosphere. Our operations focus on providing quality beverages and exceptional customer service to create a welcoming community space. We maintain a seating capacity of no more than 150 patrons to ensure a comfortable environment and adhere to strict safety protocols. Our premises are thoroughly cleaned and maintained to meet health standards, and we continuously comply with all local health and safety regulations. Our menu is carefully crafted to include brewed beverages and light meals, with no high-risk cooking methods employed, ensuring a safe dining experience. We are committed to providing our products without any alcohol service, which helps us manage liability risks effectively. Regular staff training in food safety and customer service further enhances our operational standards, keeping both our customers and team safe.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred during a recent plumbing issue on 08/15/2023 due to a pipe burst, causing damage to flooring and equipment in the coffee preparation area, amounting to $1,200. The claim is currently in processing status with the insurance provider.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 2 Safe, Grade A, Secured with Central Station Alarm
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24-hour monitoring and perimeter fencing to enhance security.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff are directly employed by the business.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House carries Workers Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees in the event of work-related injuries.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus solely on serving brewed beverages and light snacks.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus solely on providing coffee, tea, and snacks to our customers. We prioritize maintaining the quality and safety of our own equipment.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The financial standing remains stable, contributing to a solid operational foundation.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals. Our operations focus solely on serving brewed beverages and light snacks, adhering to strict safety standards.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused on providing coffee and light snacks in a well-maintained environment, adhering closely to safety standards.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House has no past losses or claims related to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize a safe and respectful environment for both our employees and customers.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Brewed Awakenings Coffee House has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations.
